top_signals.title: U.S. Energy Red Tape Gives China an Edge
top_signals.summary: Congress needs to pass the bipartisan bill on permitting reform to accelerate energy infrastructure buildout so that the United States can compete economically and industrially with China, say former economic policy and national security officials who have served six U.S. presidents. The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 was introduced in the Senate at the end of September and is expected to be debated after the mid-term elections when Congress returns from the recess on November 9. top_signals.title: Commission to investigate how Booking.com combats scams and fraud under the Digital Services Act
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 21 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission has opened formal proceedings to assess whether Booking.com may have breached the Digital Services Act (DSA) by not having diligently assessed or effectively mitigated risks related to fraudulent listings and phishing scams.
